scope: Technical Platform Core transferability and vertical onboarding
passRule: Every required criterion must be PASS, executor.isFounder must be false, and every PASS criterion must include evidence before overallStatus may be PASS.

criteria.name: source_of_truth_orientation
criteria.expectedOutcome: Executor locates Platform Core runtime, consumer contract, adoption manifest and vertical adapter boundaries without founder step-by-step instruction.

criteria.name: change_classification
criteria.expectedOutcome: Executor correctly classifies platform-semantic, vertical-adapter and presentation-only changes and identifies their required gates.

criteria.name: truth_semantics
criteria.expectedOutcome: Executor demonstrates that unknown, stale or external-unverified evidence is confirmation-needed and cannot satisfy a confirmed MUST.

criteria.name: commercial_integrity
criteria.expectedOutcome: Executor demonstrates that sponsorship/disclosure cannot alter organic score or rank.

criteria.name: safe_adapter_change
criteria.expectedOutcome: Executor can implement or review a domain-adapter change without locally redefining Platform Core confirmation, freshness, matching, safety or sponsorship semantics.

criteria.name: qa_execution
criteria.expectedOutcome: Executor identifies and runs the applicable Platform Core, Buyer-DD, transfer and vertical QA gates and ties results to an exact head.

criteria.name: rollback_dry_run
criteria.expectedOutcome: Executor documents a rollback from a candidate core version to a known-good exact core/vendor pin without treating database/data-rights rollback as implicit.

criteria.name: new_vertical_onboarding
criteria.expectedOutcome: Executor can take a hypothetical new vertical through HOY-VERTICAL-ONBOARD-1.0 and identify all missing evidence before claiming adoption.

criteria.name: independent_gate_boundary
criteria.expectedOutcome: Executor correctly identifies that production, legal, privacy, source-rights, data-commercialization and market/outreach authority are independent from code completion.

externalClaimBeforePass: HOY has documented technical transferability and a defined founder-independence acceptance test; full founder-independent operation is not yet proven.
externalClaimAfterPass: Technical Platform Core handoff has been executed by a non-founder against HOY-FI-TECH-1.0. This does not by itself prove founder-independent business operations, sales, local operations or governance.
